items.title: Kyrie (Daulphin, Missa Je n’en puis plus durer)
items.desc: Pierre Daulphin, Missa Je n’en puis plus durer, Kyrie, 1557. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
